title: Learning efficient non-rigid registration in k-space for accelerated Magnetic Resonance Imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Learning efficient non-rigid registration in k-space for accelerated Magnetic Resonance Imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Non-rigid motion estimation at high temporal resolution is essential for dynamic and real-time Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), yet remains challenging due to the spatio-temporal sampling limitations of accelerated acquisitions.
